create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with a DictConfig to initialize neural field training for object pose and SDF estimation
run_step_map: run a single map optimization step that samples points from sensors and updates the neural SDF network weights
run_step_pose: run a single pose optimization step that uses Theseus to optimize object poses against depth and tactile observations
generate_mesh_rec: generate a mesh reconstruction from the trained SDF using marching cubes and return cropped and uncropped mesh versions
compute_f_score: compute the F-score between a reconstructed mesh and the ground-truth mesh to evaluate reconstruction quality
